channel.title: News · La Paix du Cœur
channel.description: News from La Paix du Cœur: food drives, street outreach, back-to-school and life in the association.

item.title: The Heart Circle is launched: 63 founding members
item.description: Our new monthly giving programme has already gathered its first members. Goal: 100 by Christmas.

item.title: Fall food drive: your gifts filled 180 baskets
item.description: Two Saturdays at the supermarket, dozens of volunteers and a generosity that moved us.

item.title: Back to school: 95 kits for a good start
item.description: Backpacks, notebooks, pencils and calculators: thanks to you, children started school with their heads held high.
